weaknesses.area: Existing India-wide route collision and unsupported claims
weaknesses.finding: The site already has /pilot-training-in-india and /dgca-ground-classes-in-india. The latter's metadata claims online/offline delivery across all 28 states and a 25% scholarship; its body has a hard-coded states-served city list and related broad reach statements. Those claims are not substantiated by the verified business model, which only documents online batches outside Delhi and one physical classroom.
weaknesses.action: Before expanding national SEO, audit and reconcile these existing pages against first-party evidence. Do not add a third national landing page, mass city links or route redirects in this phase.

weaknesses.finding: The schema's primary telephone is +91-9667370747, while the Contact page uses +91-9355566991 for calls/WhatsApp. Two further numbers appear on airline-preparation pages with unclear ownership. LinkedIn URL also differs between schema and Footer.
weaknesses.action: Obtain owner confirmation of canonical contacts and official social URLs; then align website, schema, footer and Google Business Profile.

weaknesses.finding: CPL Course schema marks the course Blended and includes aggregate pricing and 18–24 month duration. This could be read as one academy-delivered complete CPL product, while flight training is partner-arranged and the academy's own pricing/duration scope is not established by this audit.
weaknesses.action: Confirm which offer, price and duration belong to We One Aviation versus third-party flying schools before future schema/content changes.

weaknesses.finding: Dwarka clearly explains physical classroom, remote students and partner-school flying. CPL and Delhi pages are less explicit about the same end-to-end model.
weaknesses.action: When production changes are approved, use the same verified wording and point to the national explainer rather than repeating varying claims.

weaknesses.finding: A Maps CID link exists, but current profile ownership, category, address/phone/website consistency, map pin, hours, reviews, photos and service-area fields are not independently verified.
weaknesses.action: Owner or verified manager should inspect the live profile and reconcile it with confirmed first-party facts.

weaknesses.finding: weoneaviation.com contains potentially legacy or compromised branded/location content, but ownership is unverified.
weaknesses.action: Keep DOMAIN_OWNERSHIP_UNVERIFIED and make no domain or URL changes absent proof and explicit owner direction.

recommendedNationalArchitecture.decision: Use the existing /pilot-training-in-india as the proposed national geographic/service-delivery hub after its existing content is audited and reconciled. Do not create another India-wide page or assume the current page is production-ready.
searchIntent: How pilot training in India is structured and regulated
How DGCA ground preparation, CPL requirements and flight training fit together
How students outside Delhi can access We One Aviation's online ground batches
Where the academy's actual classroom is and where partner-arranged flying occurs
recommendedNationalArchitecture.purpose: Explain the national pilot-training pathway and the academy's limited, truthful role within it: Dwarka classroom ground teaching, online ground batches for students outside Delhi, and flight training arranged through partner flying schools.
recommendedNationalArchitecture.relationshipToCplPage: The national hub explains the overall India pathway and academy delivery model; /commercial-pilot-license remains the detailed CPL eligibility, regulatory requirements and licensing authority.
recommendedNationalArchitecture.relationshipToDgcaPage: /dgca-ground-classes remains the detailed ground-subject/course authority; the national hub summarizes online versus Dwarka classroom access and links to it.

contentOutline.section: What pilot training in India involves
contentOutline.include: Regulatory pathway at a high level; distinguish ground preparation, DGCA examinations, medical requirements and practical flight training.
Ground-subject teaching and course guidance; state clearly that the academy does not own aircraft or simulators and does not make airline placements.
The single verified Dwarka address and link to /pilot-training-in-dwarka.

contentOutline.section: How students outside Delhi can access ground training
contentOutline.include: Online batches are offered to students outside Delhi; invite applicants to confirm current batch/course availability through Contact. Do not state that every city or every course has a guaranteed batch.
Flight training is arranged with partner flying schools, occurs at the relevant school rather than the Dwarka classroom, and specific partner locations/availability must be confirmed.
Concise, source-backed overview with a direct link to the CPL authority; avoid duplicating its full eligibility and regulatory treatment.

contentOutline.section: DGCA ground subjects and exam preparation
contentOutline.include: Short overview and a direct link to the DGCA Ground Classes authority; keep operational claims to verified information.

contentOutline.section: How to enquire from outside Delhi
contentOutline.include: Use existing Contact/counselling flow. Explain what a prospective student should ask about course, delivery mode, current batch availability and partner-school arrangements.
Only answer delivery/location questions from verified facts; avoid local outcomes, local batches, flight-school proximity or guaranteed availability.

Repeating a list of research markets in page copy, title, schema or footer links.
cityReferenceStrategy.policy: The online-batch statement describes mode and broad audience location, not a city service-area declaration.

nearMeStrategy.reality: The website cannot guarantee visibility for near-me searches. Search engines use the searcher's location and multiple business/entity/relevance signals.
legitimateSignals: Consistent, accurate organization name, address, primary contact and canonical domain across visible site content and structured data.
A verified Google Business Profile for the genuine physical Dwarka location, if the business meets platform eligibility and the owner confirms access.
Clear, crawlable descriptions of classroom DGCA training, online batches outside Delhi and partner-arranged flight training.
Accurate internal links between national service explanation, course authorities and real Delhi/Dwarka location pages.
Genuine official profiles and consistent links in sameAs.
Authentic, policy-compliant reviews and current profile information; no fabricated reviews or city-specific claims.
forbiddenSignals: Fake branches, service locations or LocalBusiness schema on target-city pages.
Keyword-stuffed city lists or invented city-specific student/partner claims.
